company_name: United Airlines Holdings, Inc. (fka Continental Airlines, Inc.)

fuel_consumption.source_quote: The Company's 2021 forecasted fuel consumption is presently approximately 2.1 billion gallons, and based on this forecast, a one-dollar change in the price of a barrel of crude oil would change the Company's annual fuel expense by approximately $49 million. (Severely reduced from COVID-19 impact.)

instrument_type_details.notes: Company's current strategy is to not enter into transactions to hedge fuel price volatility. FY2020 operations severely impacted by COVID-19 pandemic.

warnings: FY2020 heavily impacted by COVID-19 pandemic. Projected 2021 fuel consumption significantly reduced at 2.1 billion gallons vs ~4.5 billion pre-pandemic.
